title: Release for manuscript submission of Nasioulas et al. 2025
question: How do feedback conditions change risky choices across repeated decisions and experiments?
publisher: Nasioulas, Antonios; Potier, Elise; Cerrotti, Fabien; Lebreton, Mael; Palminteri, Stefano
measurement_dates: Exact experiment dates unknown; December 2025 release.
independent_units: participant and experiment; older comparison study separately
validation_design: participant and experiment; older comparison study separately Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Pinned archive combines new Nasioulas study observations and explicitly older Erev comparison data plus source analysis.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Participant and experiment holdouts. Do not merge older comparison study as new participants without provenance; published fitted choice models are known.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.

first_lines: EXP: number of experiment, as mentioned in the manuscript Nasioulas_2024 [values: 1-7]
BLOCK_INSTRUCTIONS: whether instructions at the beginning of each block informing about the availability of feedback in the upcoming block were present (1) or not (0)
SURETHING: whether there was a sure-thing lottery (1) or a safe low-variance 50/50 option (0)
EXPID: random unique identifier for each participant/submission
